business_problem: Headquartered in Bangkok, is a prominent subsidiary of Thailand's BTS Group, specializing in rail transport, logistics, financial services, and advertising.
solution_summary: VGI operates one of the largest digital signage networks for out-of-home (OOH) advertising in Bangkok. To help its advertisers target ad campaigns more effectively, the company built a customer data platform (CDP) on AWS. The CDP uses a combination of Amazon Redshift Elasticsearch , and Amazon RDS for its data warehouse, with AWS Glue AWS Step Functions to orchestrate extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes. The platform also uses Amazon Cognito for authentication and compliance, and AWS Lambda for easy scaling and simplified management. With its new CDP, VGI expects to expand its product portfolio and establish itself as a key data expert in the advertising and marketing technology sectors.

solution_components.role: Stores relational data that supports the personalization and recommendation workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Executes serverless processing and workflow glue for the personalization and recommendation workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Glue
solution_components.role: Transforms and prepares data used by the personalization and recommendation workflows.
